name: Aisin Corporation
summary: Aisin Corporation manufactures and sells automotive parts, lifestyle, and energy and wellness related products in Japan. It offers mobility products, including eAxle, brakes, steering, doors and roofs, aerodynamic devices, battery frame parts, cabin monitoring, MaaS, doors and roofs, and aftermarket products, as well as thermal management-, seat-, car navigation-, and engine-related products. The company also provides automatic transmission, CVT, and manual transmission products. In addition, it offers energy solutions, such as cogeneration systems for residential use, gas heat pump air-conditioner, and peltier modules.
